description_en: Update the standby video of a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live effect-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id 80787064-1c94-4dc1-85ce-9409960a0000 --scene-id 05ab713c-676e-49c0-96ce-cc408da10000 --resource-id f096e8d6-0319-4c96-82bc-ecbc79cf0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EffectCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

If you create a production studio using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, use the CasterId value from the response.

If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, find the ID on the Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page.

The name of the production studio in the list is the ID

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。
